title: Grand Hotel Esplanade, Berlin
scope: Prewar exterior of the enlarged Grand Hotel Esplanade on its original Bellevuestraße site, with the full street facade, daylight courts, skylights, and the enclosed formal garden visible in 1928.
limitations: The reconstruction shows the hotel after its 1911–12 expansion. The conservative date range covers the documented prewar form and ends before wartime damage.

Roof details, exact stone shades, portal relief carving, garden planting and fine courtyard fittings are approximations. The site represents the main connected hotel and its garden, excluding the row of service buildings farther behind the property.
Modern source terrain is independent of the historic building and provides an approximate site datum.
